newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese banks launch stock index linked bonds.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese banks launch stock index linked bonds.

text.p: Banco Santander de Negocios Portugal (BSNP) and Banco de Comercio e Industria (BCI) launched three billion escudos of three-year bonds indexed to the PSI-20 stock index, said BSNP, which is issue leader and organiser.
The bonds pay 90 percent of the average three-month gain of the PSI-20 index of leading shares, with a guarantee of a minimum yield of six percent.
Subscription began on April 28 and runs until May 16.
The PSI-20 .PSI20 has risen 22 percent since the start of the year.
